hero.eyebrow: From the fertile lands of the Nile Delta to the finest tables around the world.
hero.titleA: A journey that begins in land we inherited with pride,
hero.titleB: and ends on your customers’ tables.
hero.storyP1: Generations of our family have farmed the Nile Delta — learning the silt, the water and the turn of the season from the people who worked it before them. The land came to us as a responsibility rather than a business, and we keep it with what this generation was given: tested soil, measured irrigation, controlled curing rooms.
hero.storyP2: What we grow, we see through. Harvest, sorting, packing, cold storage, export — one journey, managed by us, so the crop never changes hands without someone here answering for it. And every sweet potato we set aside is chosen against a single question: will it still be right when it reaches your customer?
hero.quote: Nothing leaves our hands that we would not put on our own table.

trust.title: Four ways a produce import goes wrong
trust.sub: And what we have in place so it doesn’t happen to your container.

items.risk: Arrival quality doesn’t match the sample you approved.
items.fix: Pre-shipment inspection with dated photos of the actual lot, sent before the container leaves.

items.risk: Certificates that can’t be checked — or belong to someone else.
items.fix: Scheme number, validity and certifying body for every credential, so you can verify them at source.

items.risk: A gap in the cold chain that nobody can account for.
items.fix: A data-logger in every reefer; the full temperature trace is handed over on arrival.
One named contact who replies within four hours, Sunday to Friday.

items.q: Can we audit your farm and packhouse?
items.a: Yes — in person or by video call, whenever suits you. We will also host a third-party audit at your request.

items.q: Which certifications do you actually hold?
items.a: The schemes listed above, and only those. Certificate copies, with numbers and validity dates, are provided to qualified buyers on request.
Every carton carries a lot code that maps back to the field, the harvest date and the packing shift. We can trace forward or back within four hours.

items.q: Do you test for pesticide residues?
items.a: Yes — against EU maximum residue limits under Regulation 396/2005, with a residue report available per shipment.

items.q: What happens if a load arrives out of spec?
items.a: Send photos and the logger file as soon as possible after discharge. We assess the claim against our own pre-shipment record; how a confirmed claim is settled is set out in the contract for your shipment.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: El Molouk is a business-to-business exporter of fresh produce. This policy explains what personal data we handle when you contact us or use this website, why we handle it, and the rights you have over it.

sections.title: Who is responsible
sections.body: Kings For Import & Export, trading as El Molouk, is the controller of the data described here. Our full company and contact details are listed at the foot of this page.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Only what you send us. Our enquiry form asks for a destination port, a volume, a company e-mail address and, optionally, an Incoterm and a message. If you write to us by e-mail, telephone or WhatsApp, we hold that correspondence. Our hosting provider records standard technical logs, such as IP address and browser type, in order to serve and secure the site.

sections.title: Why we use it, and on what basis
sections.body: To answer your enquiry, prepare a quotation and, if you go ahead, perform the resulting contract — the basis for which is the performance of a contract, or steps taken at your request before entering one. Keeping records of business correspondence and protecting this site rest on our legitimate interests. We do not use your details for automated decision-making or profiling, and we never sell them.

sections.title: Who else sees it, and for how long we keep it
sections.body: Nobody beyond what is necessary. If you choose to send your enquiry through WhatsApp, the message travels through that service under its own terms. Our hosting provider processes technical logs on our behalf. Details are shared with freight forwarders, inspection bodies or authorities only where a shipment you have ordered requires it. Enquiries that do not lead to business are kept for up to 24 months; records connected to an actual shipment are kept for as long as commercial and customs law requires.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: This site sets no advertising, analytics or tracking cookies. One functional cookie records the language you are reading in, so the site does not switch language on you between pages.

sections.title: Your rights, and changes to this policy
sections.body: If you are in the EU, the UK or another jurisdiction with comparable law, you may ask us for a copy of your data, ask us to correct or erase it, ask us to restrict or stop a particular use, or ask for it in a portable form. Write to the e-mail address below and we will respond within 30 days. You also have the right to complain to your national data protection authority. If this policy changes, the date above will change with it.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of this website. They are not a contract of sale: the terms on which we supply goods are agreed in writing for each order.

sections.title: Who these terms are with
sections.body: This website is operated by Kings For Import & Export, trading as El Molouk. It is intended for business users — importers, wholesalers and processors — and not for consumers.

sections.title: Information on this site
sections.body: Product descriptions, calibres, packaging formats, loading capacities and availability are given in good faith as a guide for planning. Loading figures are approximate and vary with final carton dimensions and packing configuration. Nothing here is a specification you can rely on until it has been confirmed in writing for your order.

sections.title: Quotations and orders
sections.body: A quotation is an invitation to do business rather than a binding offer, and is valid only for the period stated on it. A contract comes into existence when we confirm your order in writing. Our minimum order quantity is 5 metric tons.

sections.title: Certifications and documentation
sections.body: Certificates, audit reports and shipment documents are issued by third-party bodies and by public authorities. We provide current copies to qualified buyers on request and with quotations. We make no representation about a scheme we do not hold, and we display no scheme logo we are not entitled to use.

sections.title: Prices, delivery and claims
sections.body: Prices, Incoterms® 2020 rules, loading port, delivery windows, inspection arrangements and the handling of any quality claim are agreed per order and set out in the contract for that shipment, together with the law governing it. Where this website and a signed contract differ, the contract governs.

sections.title: Intellectual property, liability and changes
sections.body: The text, photographs and layout of this site belong to us or are used with permission and may not be reproduced commercially without our written consent; third-party scheme names and logos remain the property of their owners. We take care to keep this site accurate and available, but we do not warrant that it is uninterrupted or free of error, and we are not liable for decisions taken on the basis of the website alone rather than a confirmed written specification. Nothing here limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited. We may update these terms; the date above shows when they last changed.
